title: 不是可怜你 · Not Pity
description: 大家都走了，戈尔贡却还在桌子后面。阿登想关心他，为什么反而让谈话变得更难了？

sources.title: Super Supportive — Sleyca
sources.note: User-supplied SHA-verified EPUB, SEVEN: A Little Delusional. Gorgon’s lack of a bedroom, Alden’s food-delivery speculation, loneliness, photographs and plush toys, and unwanted pity. Ends when Alden straightens and clears his throat before changing the topic to crickets. Simplified Mandarin with reflective rejoining choices; silent watch adaptation.

notice: This episode adapts Super Supportive by Sleyca. Conversations are simplified for Mandarin reading, and choices vary your response while preserving the story’s events.
